questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of productivity tools for high school students, as described in the chapter?

options.text: To increase screen time and social media engagement.
To help organize time, manage tasks, and work more efficiently.
To replace the need for studying and homework.
To complicate daily schedules with unnecessary features.

questions.question_text: Which type of productivity tool is best suited for helping students stay focused during study sessions?

options.text: Task Management Apps like Todoist.
Calendar and Scheduling Tools like Google Calendar.
Time Management and Focus Apps like Forest or Pomodoro timers.
Collaboration Tools like Google Docs.

questions.question_text: What is an important feature to consider when choosing a task management app, according to the chapter?

options.text: The app’s ability to play music in the background.
Cross-platform syncing to access tasks on multiple devices.
The app’s popularity on social media platforms.
The number of games included in the app.

questions.question_text: Why does the chapter recommend starting with just one or two task management apps?

options.text: Using multiple apps at once can be confusing and time-consuming.
Most apps are expensive and require subscriptions.
Students should avoid technology as much as possible.
Task management apps are only effective for professionals, not students.

questions.question_text: How can time tracking apps like RescueTime benefit high school students?

options.text: They help students spend more time on social media without guilt.
They show how much time is spent on studying versus distractions.
They automatically complete assignments for students.
They limit access to educational resources to save time.

questions.question_text: What is a recommended step for using progress tracking tools effectively, as outlined in the chapter?

options.text: Track every possible activity to get the most data.
Review progress data regularly to spot trends and make adjustments.
Ignore the data if progress is slower than expected.
Use only paid apps for accurate tracking results.
